name: Jeffrey Skilling

summary.text: Jeffrey Skilling was chief executive of Enron Corporation before its December 2001 bankruptcy. A federal jury in Houston convicted him on May 25, 2006 of conspiracy, securities fraud, insider trading and making false statements to auditors. He was sentenced to 292 months in October 2006; the Fifth Circuit affirmed the convictions in 2009 but vacated the sentence, and in June 2013 he was resentenced to 168 months and ordered to forfeit about $42 million for victims under an agreement that ended further challenges to his conviction.
